# Pipes — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.583c665f"></a>**1. The unit defines FileValidationPipe, an @Injectable() class implementing NestJS PipeTransform<MulterFile, MulterFile>, which validates uploaded files before they reach the upload handler.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:1-5`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L1-L5)
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:25-26`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L25-L26)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.1da762c0"></a>**2. The pipe's transform method throws a BadRequestException carrying FileValidationError.NO_FILE_PROVIDED with message 'No file provided' when no file is supplied.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:28-33`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L28-L33)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.b3934f5d"></a>**3. The pipe's transform method throws a BadRequestException carrying FileValidationError.INVALID_FILE_TYPE when the file's mimetype is not the allowed 'application/pdf' MIME type.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:17-17`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L17-L17)
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:35-40`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L35-L40)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.5d2f6012"></a>**4. The pipe's transform method throws a BadRequestException carrying FileValidationError.FILE_TOO_LARGE when the file's size exceeds the 10MB maximum.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:16-16`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L16-L16)
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:42-47`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L42-L47)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.43edab1e"></a>**5. The pipe's transform method returns the validated file unchanged when it passes all validation checks.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:49-49`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L49-L49)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.8b544a92"></a>**6. The unit defines the MulterFile interface describing the shape of an uploaded file: fieldname, originalname, encoding, mimetype, size, and buffer.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:7-14`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L7-L14)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.272f15f3"></a>**7. The unit defines MAX_FILE_SIZE as 10 * 1024 * 1024 bytes (10MB), the maximum accepted upload size, and ALLOWED_MIME_TYPE as 'application/pdf', the only accepted upload MIME type.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:16-17`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L16-L17)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.3178fd79"></a>**8. The unit defines the FileValidationError enum with the members INVALID_FILE_TYPE, FILE_TOO_LARGE, and NO_FILE_PROVIDED.**
  [`file-validation.pipe.ts:19-23`](../file-validation.pipe.ts#L19-L23)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.3b37c851"></a>**9. FileValidationPipe is applied to the uploadPdf handler in backend/src/upload/upload.controller.ts via @UploadedFile(new FileValidationPipe()), so uploaded files are validated before UploadService.processUpload runs.**
  [`upload.controller.ts:19-19`](../../../upload/upload.controller.ts#L19-L19)
  [`upload.controller.ts:22-22`](../../../upload/upload.controller.ts#L22-L22)
  [`upload.controller.ts:173-173`](../../../upload/upload.controller.ts#L173-L173)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-pipes.76a3193e"></a>**10. The unit's MulterFile type is imported by backend/src/upload/upload.service.ts to type the upload processing input.**
  [`upload.service.ts:8-8`](../../../upload/upload.service.ts#L8-L8)
